formula: mana = max(0, baseline_tokens - actual_tokens) * Q; Q capped at 1; Q=0 if safety failure or quality <95% of baseline

rules.baseline: task-matched, reproducible, versioned; no retroactive changes
rules.quality: independent rubric; Q=0 for safety failure or quality below 95% of baseline
rules.Q: min(1, quality_score / baseline_quality) when eligible; 0 otherwise
rules.privacy: no credentials/private data in ledger; evidence hashes only
rules.independence: quality assessment independent of the optimizing Citizen; no self-awarded mana
rules.record: provider/model, workload, input/output tokens, latency, cost, quality, uncertainty, evidence hash
rules.mana_boundary: mana is an efficiency metric, not authority, identity, currency or execution permission
